name: Command Center
summary: Stormwind's army is thinned by campaigns abroad, and recruits drill in the Command Center. Also called the Stormwind Barracks, it houses the city's officers and a seasoned crew focused on training recruits and local militia.

sections.title: A Thin Line of Defense
sections.body: In Old Town, Stormwind's Command Center trains the kingdom's soldiers. Much of the royal army serves abroad, leaving its halls quieter than usual. Veteran instructors Ander Germaine and martial artist Wu Shen drill fresh warriors to strengthen the city's defenses.

sections.title: Old Town's Martial Hub
sections.body: When you seek instruction in heavy arms or tactical combat, Stormwind's guards may direct you to the Barracks. It stands near the Pig and Whistle Tavern and Old Town's shadowy operations. The training ground helps keep order in a district known for tavern brawls and roguish activity.

faq.q: Why is the Command Center so empty?
faq.answer: Most of Stormwind's standing army serves at distant outposts and on foreign battlefields across the world. A seasoned crew remains to instruct recruits and organize local defense.

faq.q: Is the Command Center the same as the Stormwind Barracks?
aliases: are command center and barracks the same
faq.answer: Yes. The building's official name is the Command Center, though guards and residents often call it the Stormwind Barracks when giving directions.
Ander Germaine coordinates and trains Stormwind's warriors, alongside instructors such as Wu Shen and Ilsa Corbin.

faq.q: Where is the Command Center located?
faq.answer: You find the Command Center in Old Town, near the Pig and Whistle Tavern and the district's training facilities.

angles.text: As a warrior, you can train at Stormwind's Command Center. Veterans such as Ander Germaine and Wu Shen teach recruits to fight as disciplined frontline soldiers.
